comment: Each remaining RDY-010 evidence gap is acknowledged, tracked, and release-blocking. The validator downgrades exactly these absent types to warnings so blocking CI can enforce everything else; it fails if an undeclared gap appears, and it also fails once a declared gap's evidence becomes available, so this ledger can only shrink. The lifecycle producer/consumer workflow contract is implemented but requires a hosted exact-SHA run before it is release evidence; profile-scoped package smoke remains owned by MOD-310. RDY-010 stays open until no required gap or unhosted proof remains.

gaps.reason: Tests/PackageSmoke registers SparkInstalledPackageSmoke, but it runs only in .github/workflows/release.yml and is not scoped to a module profile, so it produces no per-module package evidence in blocking CI. MOD-310 owns closing this.
